f0001.note: Eighteen failures across three unrelated modules — filesystem, Delta Lake, Iceberg — all saying the same thing in different words: objects deleted from GCS are still there afterwards. 'Expecting value to be false but was true' on exists(), leftover blobs after vacuum and cleanup, 'Table location should not exist', and a register_table that was expected to fail on a dropped table and did not. Grouping across the module boundary is the whole point: the symptoms differ and the cause is one storage layer not honouring deletes. Environment rather than product because three independently maintained connectors do not regress identically in one run.
